title: DoorDash and Upside Partner to Give DashPass Members Relief at the Gas Pump
summary: Claim a gas offer in the DoorDash app before heading to the pump to get up to 25¢/gal back in DoorDash credits, plus an extra 50¢/gal on your first fill-up
body_markdown:
Today, with[millions of Americans](https://newsroom.aaa.com/2026/11/aaa-thanksgiving-holiday-travel-forecast/) about to hit the road for the holidays, DoorDash and Upside are giving DashPass members some good news at the pump: **up to 25¢/gal back** * in DoorDash credits at more than 20,000 participating stations. Head to the[Gas Rewards tab](https://www.doordash.com/dineout/dashboard?product_id=3&utm_source=doordash&utm_medium=PR&utm_campaign=gas_nationwide_q426&utm_external_link=dineout) in the DoorDash app to claim a nearby gas reward, fill up, and pay with your linked card to start earning credits.


Credits can be used on any DoorDash order: today's fill-up can help cover tonight's dinner, this week's groceries, or whatever's next on your list. Gas Rewards are powered by[Upside](https://www.upside.com/) , the country’s largest marketplace of in-store offers at gas stations, grocery stores, and restaurants.


**To kick things off, DashPass members can earn an extra 50¢/gal, meaning up to 75¢/gal back on their first fill-up.**


> "From filling up the tank to shopping for weekly groceries, everyday costs add up,” said **Rob Edell, Vice President of DashPass at DoorDash** . “In partnership with Upside, we're bringing customers gas rewards from participating stations across the country just in time for the busy holiday travel season, so weekly fill-ups can earn credits back toward future orders. Whether it’s Tuesday night dinner, weekly groceries, household essentials, or your holiday shopping, DashPass is about helping members save on everyday needs, and that now includes a trip to the gas station."


> “Upside has delivered more than $1 billion in cash back to consumers, and it works for one simple reason: the retailers funding those rewards win business they’d otherwise miss. This partnership brings that model to DashPass members, turning a routine fill-up into something that gives back,” said Chad Crutchfield, Vice President of Strategic Partnerships at Upside.


**Gas Rewards in Three Steps + A Little Extra on Your First Fill-Up**


No coupons to clip and no receipts to scan. Everything happens in the DoorDash app:


-


**Add an eligible card** : Add an eligible Visa or Mastercard in the Gas tab to start earning credits on gas with DashPass.


-


**Claim a nearby gas offer** : Open the Gas tab, find a gas offer near you, and claim it before you fill up.


-


**Fill up and pay with your linked physical card** : Use the card linked to your DoorDash account to pay for your gas, and earn **up to 25¢/gal back** in DoorDash credits on every claimed offer. Credits can be used on any future DoorDash order.


**One Tab, More Ways to Earn**


DashPass members get more from their neighborhood for less, with exclusive benefits and more savings on everyday needs. Gas rewards also live in the In-Store Rewards tab alongside other ways to earn rewards in your neighborhood — from dine-out deals to movie tickets — all part of DoorDash's effort to make everyday life more rewarding.


Open the DoorDash app, head to the Gas tab, and find gas rewards near you. Your next fill-up could earn you credits.


** Offer powered by Upside. Offer available in select markets. Must have an active DashPass account. Offers claimed in the In-Store or Gas Rewards tab in the DoorDash app may not be claimed in the Upside app, or in any other apps powered by Upside, by the same user during the offer period. If claimed, you agree to DoorDash and Upside exchanging information to verify eligibility and issue DoorDash credits. If duplicate claims are made at the same site, you will receive credits for only one offer. Offer must be claimed in the In-Store or Gas Rewards tab in the DoorDash app before purchase and expires approximately four (4) hours after activation. Offer good at location referenced in the app only. Offer valid for first 50 gallons of gas purchased. If combined with other discounts, DoorDash credit may be reduced by up to 5 cents per gallon. DoorDash credit amount will be determined by the number of gallons and the offer for the grade of gas purchased. If receipt doesn’t include the grade of gas, you will receive the applicable credit amount for regular-grade gas. User may be asked to provide proof of purchase. Gas sign prices shown are not always current or accurate, due to limitations in data reporting. A maximum of two (2) offers may be claimed at the same location within 24 hours. Must use a qualifying payment method and complete the transaction as required to be eligible for the DoorDash credits. See DoorDash’s*[Privacy Policy](https://help.doordash.com/en-us/legal/article/cx-privacy-policy) *and Upside’s*[TOS](https://www.upside.com/data-and-security/terms) *and*[Privacy Policy](https://www.upside.com/data-and-security/privacy-policy) *for more information.*
